# Snowfield

> Snowfield LLC is an applied AI studio based in Indianapolis, Indiana. Its first trade offer is a job intake build for owner-run plumbing and sewer shops.

## What the build includes
- After-hours and overflow call intake on the shop's existing phone number and website form; urgent calls go to one on-call alert path the owner chooses, and estimate requests arrive as short job sheets.
- Consent-based follow-up on large quotes (sewer line, water heater, repipe): up to four messages over 14 days, stopping on a reply or opt-out.
- A one-page talk track for the sewer replacement conversation and a live 30-minute crew walkthrough.

## Terms
- Built inside accounts the shop owns; the shop keeps the accounts, number and records.
- One-time setup fee and optional monthly care that starts only after written go-live approval. Pricing is worked out on a 15-minute intake review call with the shop's own numbers.
- No guaranteed calls, jobs or revenue.
